note: A Code LLM specialized for the SLeeLa programming language. Verification is the SLeeLa compiler itself (impl/build/sleela check/run); until that runs, the native static verifier catches SLeeLa's known gotchas. The model is user-supplied; SLeeLa ships the rule knowledge and verifier contract, not weights.

runtime_reserved.close: no-arg method named close() collides with the Munction reach-handle builtin at RUNTIME (parses fine). Rename, e.g. sealMoment()/requestClose().

comment_forms.angle_line: < ... >  (single line; opener and closer on one line; must be first non-whitespace on its line)
comment_forms.angle_block: << ... >>  (multi-line; required for any comment spanning >1 line)
comment_forms.unsupported: /* ... */ is NOT a comment; '/*' lexes as '/' then '*'
pitfalls: A '<' single-line comment that spans multiple lines fails to parse; use '<< >>' for multi-line.
An inline trailing '< comment >' after code on the same line is a parse error; put it on its own line.
An apostrophe (') inside an angle comment is a lexical error; reword to avoid possessives/contractions.

limits.remedy: Pack related handles into one array field reached via accessor methods (methods cost no layout slot), or split the class.

metadata_class_metapattern.required_for: every new SLeeLa class (team standing preference; see .kiro/steering/metadata-class-standard.md)
metadata_class_metapattern.rule: values must be faithful to the subject's real origin; unknown => 'none'/'unknown', never fabricated
